West core area of Leuser Ecosystem, separated from East forests by roads and settlements. Intact forests mostly dominated by hill and mountain forests. This forest patch is definitely more intact than one in Bukit Barisan Selatan, mostly due to the vast size and difficult access. Some high-integrity forest areas are outside the KBA boundary.

High integrity tropical forests. This is part of the Intensive Protection Zone of Bukit Barisan Selatan National Park. It is well protected and retains most of the primary forests, although human activities are present due to its elongated shape (easier to access from the east and west sides). At the north and south of this polygon, there are two national roads cutting through the forests. 

Some of the north and south blocks of the national park harbour intact forests too, but are mixed with settlements; therefore, I excluded them for now. Local expert can help in delineate the polygons in these parts.

Note: Compared to Leuser Ecosystem at North, this forests have more human activities due to easy access, but the forest is still remains pretty intact.
Cleared/degraded forest converted to coffee plantation

Kerinci Seblat is one of the largest forest landscape in Sumatra, I believe it should become a reference area for forest. But I am not familiar with this landscape therefore I added this note in case folks from WWF want to check this.

East core area of Leuser Ecosystem, separated from West forests by roads and settlements. Also intact forest dominated by hill and mountain forests; the vegetation is slightly different with the east (e.g., in higher elevation (>2000 m) we can still find large trees, while in West Leuser not). It remains intact due to its large size and difficult access.

High Integrity - Tropical Savanna inside Kakadu national park, a very large area with limited human impact. Some invasive species present (e.g. Buffalo, goats) but composition otherwise quite intact.
High Integrity subtropical rainforest and wet sclerophyl forest inside a large and well managed national park. Structure and species composition should all be fairly intact.

Medium/Low Integrity Eucalpytus Forest - small remnant patch but heavily used by mountain bikers, dog walkers etc. Species composition substantially altered with likely loss of Koala, a number of important bird species etc.

Designated wilderness, no permanent structures, no motorized recreation. Contains a combination of relatively natural forest (some areas burned in the 1800s so not "old growth), relatively high elevation areas including natural alpine vegetation and naturally open areas above treeline, some natural disturbance (landslides), also natural lakes as well as man-made (dammed rivers)
